remarks: Rare opportunity to rent in the costal community of Marvin Beach. Just steps from the neighborhood's "Second Beach," Norwalk Harbor, and Long Island Sound, this cottage offers sunset views and a peaceful coastal retreat. This is a rare opportunity to rent in one of Connecticut's most charming coastal enclaves. This charming 1920 Craftsman home is tucked into the heart of the historic Marvin Beach Association, a 120-home seaside village in East Norwalk. Beautifully renovated, preserving original details, this home is filled with light, with water views from its inviting all-season sunporch and front yard. Hardwood floors are complemented by built-in cabinetry, original fixtures, and a signature 1920s door chime.
